index.description: 1-based position of this function in the upstream plan functions array

desiredCfps.description: CFP budget copied from the upstream plan function's estimatedCfps; sizes businessRules (rule req/business-rule-count)

reqNo.description: Requirement number copied verbatim from the upstream plan artifact's top-level reqNo (display context for the solution-document format)

reqTitle.description: Requirement title copied verbatim from the upstream plan artifact's top-level reqTitle (display context)

l1Name.description: Level 1 function name copied verbatim from the upstream plan function's l1Name (functions[targetIndex-1])

l2Name.description: Level 2 function name copied verbatim from the upstream plan function's l2Name; present only when the plan declared it (moduleLevels >= 2)

l3Name.description: Level 3 function name copied verbatim from the upstream plan function's l3Name; present only when the plan declared it (moduleLevels = 3)

kind.description: Who the functional user is: a person role, an organizational role, an in-project system, or a third-party system (from the project context roles / thirdPartySystems)
